OpenRouter — pure-DeepSeek dataset generation, FIRST attempt lost. Ran 60 min, reached 109/150 samples, then the process exited with no traceback and no output files. sample_prompts.py only writes critiqued_prompts.json at the very END, so all 109 samples were unrecoverable. Relaunched under setsid, which succeeded. Follow-up: the pipeline has no incremental checkpointing, so any interruption in an hour-long run loses everything.

Together — da-deepseek-v3 finetune (ft-c9ffe696-94ea), the 6th teacher-grid v3 arm. Same config as the other five: Qwen3-14B, r=64, 4 epochs, packing on, val + n_evals=10. Billed the $4 tier minimum. NOTE: this adapter has NOT yet been evaluated — the pod was gone before its eval arm could run.

OpenRouter grading — 8 msm_eval runs (base + 5 teacher arms + 2 persona) that were INVALID: Inspect's plain `openai/` provider silently drops extra_body, so chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking=False never reached vLLM and every run executed with thinking ON while its name said -nothink. Retained as a thinking-ON secondary arm (tmp/msm-eval/*-THINKING-ON) rather than deleted, but they do not answer the question the grid was built for. Guard added in commit 477b30c.

OpenRouter grading — 8 msm_eval runs, thinking-OFF re-run via the openai-api/vllm provider form (base + sonnet5/haiku45/nano/opus48/hybrid + 2 persona), 180 samples each, Sonnet 4.6 grader. These are the results of record: data/misalignment-eval/teacher-grid-v3.csv and persona-sweep-v3.csv.

RunPod — a1-fix1 repair day: pod bmsg8y72luulm1 8xH100 resumed ~13:10, stopped ~16:15 CDT (~3.1h, ~$74). Root cause of confetti found via community reports (Qwen2.5 base ships untrained/tied embedding+lm_head rows for ChatML specials; linear-only LoRA cannot select <|im_end|>). Fix: LoRA on embed_tokens+lm_head. Trained packed 53min/loss 0.74, strict junk test CLEAN (0/120 foreign, 118/120 stops), released as elicit-A1-tablefix. Also found+fixed vLLM stop-token measurement artifact (base generation_config beats --override-generation-config; stop ids now per-request). FA3/CUDA-13: kernel verified fwd+bwd on H100, blocked at LF<->transformers<->kernels version matrix, recipe documented for later. Pod STOPPED not terminated (per AW), ~$2/day volume.

RunPod — FA3/CUDA-13 environment completion (per AW): pod bmsg8y72luulm1 8xH100 resumed ~2h (~$48). Outcome: FA3 training env WORKS end-to-end (torch 2.13+cu130, transformers 5.14.1, kernels 0.15.2, LF 0.9.5 + 3 documented patches, all encoded as setup.sh lf-fa3 arm). Correctness proven: exact packed-segment isolation (logit diff 0.0000). Speed verdict: NO gain over FA2 at 8192-ctx ZeRO-3 (11.0 vs 11.1 s/step) — attention is a small share of step time; revisit for 16k+ contexts. Debug chain: LF metadata pins -> transformers 5.6.0/kernels API break -> resolved-kernel-name string mismatch in LF collator (dense 4D mask -> 120GiB allocs) -> segment-mask unpad. Pod STOPPED again (~$2/day volume).

RunPod — prebaked-image validation: pod img-test 1xA100-SXM ~25 min (~$1.25). Result: ghcr.io/anastasiakwei/sft-training:v1 pulls anonymously, setup.sh fast path fires (BAKED-IMAGE), full setup in 104 seconds vs ~25 minutes on the stock image. Terminated immediately.
